name: grid_path
description: FFX-2 live build 25501027: the Garment Grid layout rules (FFX2-G09): gate number 0x5eb2a0, gate state and all-worn 0x5eb7d0 / 0x5eb920, the path finder 0x5eb080 and the commit of a move 0x5f51a0 with the gate evaluation 0x5f4170, run in the ffxparity emulator on the 64 real cards. A stratified subset (the vectors are the game's own answers; `layouts` is the 64 cards as numbers: nodes [gate, x, y], links [a, b] by link id).
